subject: Activation sprint: success metrics, gating, and owner rollup
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Garcia <lauren.garcia@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Activation sprint: success metrics, gating, and owner rollup

Hi Lauren / Tom —

Great call this morning. Quick recap and a concrete activation sprint proposal so we can lock dates/resources. Key objectives below and a short list of asks to unblock kickoff: 

POC objective (30 days): validate Redwood’s latency & cost profile against Acme Health’s batch extraction + real-time triage workflow while preserving PHI controls.

Primary success metrics (Agreed on call):
- Latency: median end-to-end response (inference + network) <= 350ms for 95% of production-like requests.
- Cost: tokenized inference cost <= $0.012 per 1k tokens (target; allow +/– 15% on first run).
- Quality: top-1 intent accuracy >= 92% on Acme’s annotated sample set of 5k queries.
- Security: logs and audit trail available to Acme for the trial window; private VPC peering validated.

Timeline proposal (high level):
- Week 0 (kickoff): network checklist, credentials, dataset handoff, kickoff demo (target: Oct 20)
- Week 1: staging ingest + initial model tuning; baseline perf readout
- Week 2: iterative tuning + integration tests (batch and streaming)
- Week 3: regression/quality verification and final readout

Owners (Redwood): Marissa — infra & staging; Stephanie — model config / evaluation; Jordan — PM & customer coordination.

Asks for Acme (to confirm by EOD Tue 10/16):
1) Provide the 5k annotated sample set (CSV, redacted PHI) and a short schema doc.
2) Confirm network contact and preferred peering window (Tom?)
3) Approve kickoff window: Tue Oct 20 or Wed Oct 21 (30–45m)

I attached a first-pass POC_SOW_v1.pdf that captures scope, non-prod data handling, and tentative success gates. Please flag any redlines early so we don’t slip the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a short run so we can validate value quickly.

—Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Garcia <lauren.garcia@acmehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation sprint: success metrics, gating, and owner rollup

Thanks Jordan — good recap. Tom and I aligned on the high level and we can support the timeline with two clarifications: 

1) Success metric nuance: the 92% intent accuracy target is fine for the annotated set, but for production evaluation we need a separate "safety" metric — false positives for PHI extraction must be <0.5% on a 10k holdout. Can Redwood include that in the evaluation rubric?

2) Procurement/network: our security team needs the network diagram and a short list of ports/IP ranges required for peering. Attaching the internal network diagram we discussed (acme_network_diagram.png). Our security lead (Tom) will be the peering contact; Tom, can you propose peering windows next week?

We can do the kickoff on Wed Oct 21 at 10:00am ET — Lauren/Tom + data engineering and security will attend.

Also: procurement asked for a light coverage note on how logs are retained during trial (we prefer 30 days) and how data is isolated. If you can include that in the kickoff materials, helpful.

On attachments: the annotated sample will come from our analytics team by Monday 10/19.

Best,
Lauren
Director, Product — Acme Health

-----Original Message-----
On Thu, Oct 14, 2026 at 9:12 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> (see above recap)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Garcia <lauren.garcia@acmehealth.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-16T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation sprint: success metrics, gating, and owner rollup

Appreciate the clarity, Jordan + Lauren. Quick notes from our side and proposed owner-level checklist so everyone knows immediate next steps: 

Marissa (Infra/Staging) — Action: send network checklist + peering template; coordinate with Tom for a 2-hour peering window with our infra team. Target: 10/18 for template; aim to schedule peering 10/21-10/23. Attachment: small checklist will be uploaded to the kickoff Drive folder.

Stephanie (Model/Evals) — Action: draft evaluation rubric that includes the safety metric Lauren requested (PHI false positive <0.5% on holdout). Will also include test harness for the 5k annotated set and the 10k holdout. Draft due: 10/19 EOD.

Jordan (PM) — Action: finalize kickoff agenda, circulate updated POC_SOW with the 30-day log retention callout, and add a short procurement note on data isolation. Will follow up with a calendar invite for Wed 10/21 10:00am ET.

Lauren / Tom — can you confirm which Slack channel we should use for day-to-day updates during the POC and whether data will be delivered to our SFTP or via Drive link?

I’ll create a small ownership table in the Drive folder and will mark the action owners + due dates.

—Marissa
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

> On Oct 15, 2026, Lauren wrote: "our security team needs the network diagram..."
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Garcia <lauren.garcia@acmehealth.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly check-in: status, blockers, and next-step nudges (week 2)

Hi all — weekly status nudge as we enter week 2 (staging + tuning phase). Short status + explicit asks so this is easy to action.

Status (quick):
- Dataset: Acme analytics confirmed deliverable; we received a partial CSV (3k/5k) on 10/19. Remaining 2k expected 11/05.
- Network: Marissa completed the peering template; Tom and Acme infra tentatively scheduled peering for 11/04 02:00–04:00 PT.
- Eval rubric: Stephanie posted the draft rubric in the Drive folder; includes PHI safety check.

Blockers / open asks (action owners):
1) Stephanie: finalize the evaluation harness with the holdout splitter we discussed — deliverable due 11/06 EOD.
2) Tom (Acme): confirm peering maintenance window for 11/04 and share any firewall exceptions required by 11/02 EOD.
3) Acme analytics: deliver remaining 2k annotated rows or confirm scope reduction to 3k by 11/05.
4) Jordan / Marissa: schedule a 30-minute staging smoke test for 11/05 11am PT (calendar invite upcoming).

If any of these timelines are tight for you, please call it out here — we can adjust the week-3 readout accordingly but want transparency.

Next steps: I’ll send an updated POC_SOW_v1 (marked v1.1) after peering confirmation that includes the 30-day logs retention note and the PHI safety acceptance criteria.

Thanks — small asks this week; want to keep momentum.

—Jordan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: POC_SOW_v1.pdf, acme_network_diagram.png
